title: Weeqa Dagal Toobbe Xongolo
intro: Atu zulmi madab tekkeh tan ayyuntak fayya inta xongolo taabbe. Faxe cayli mayballa weeqah gacsa mali; Wohuk muxxi, saanih essero Yalla guftaah, gacsi kaadu qibaadah sorkocô baxat radah. iyyaay too malkit abtem, manni essero kataytem, ​​kee manni numma diggowtem?
clues: Anu inni dariifal yan marih zulmit taqbiteh.
Anu woo weeqa saanih Yalla fan cankah weeqah addat xongolo abe.
Yalli malkit yoobbeeh, anu innih elle aamineh an innal gexkalootut gacse.
gacsi esserem anu mannal radeyyo Yallal aaminem, usuk tiyaay, daga raaqa.
Anu tokkeek Yalli kaafiritte ummattah macah racmattam essere.
Anu Uzayir, Suurat Az-Zukhruf addal Yalli kay weeqa yoobbe numu axcuk muggaaqisne.

trial.answer: Yallat yakke zulmi wagittaamal malkit abaanama.

options: Yalli malkit yoobbeh tonnah qibaadah inkittiino kee daga raqta degelti diggoose.

outcome.answer: Yalli malkit yoobbeh tonnah qibaadah inkittiino kee daga raqta degelti diggoose.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
